Proves AR-6's `inRange` operator on an `int64` field with both boundaries inclusive (`fromInclusive: true, toInclusive: true`) — SEM-4 requires the compiler to read the explicit inclusivity flags literally from the IR node rather than assuming SQL `BETWEEN`'s inclusive-inclusive default. AG Grid's native `inRange` wire shape (`{filterType:'number', type:'inRange', filter, filterTo}`) carries no inclusivity flags at all, so it cannot by itself distinguish this case from 042's (same field, same bounds, opposite inclusivity) — this fixture therefore uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point to inject a `rangeComparisonNode` with explicit `fromInclusive`/`toInclusive` flags directly, per the category README's rationale (mirroring 005/006/036/038's own use of `customFilters` for adapter-unreachable shapes).
